name: org_graph_changes_between
description: What changed in the Org Graph between two UTC dates: joiners (with every fact and membership and the units they own on their first day), leavers, person fact changes (title, level, manager, cost centre, site, employment), memberships started, ended or changed, moves between units, and units created, renamed, moved, retired, succeeded or re-owned. by "effective" (the default) lists what took effect after from, up to and including to; known_on reads what the Org Graph knew at 23:59:59 UTC on that date, not in the tenant's local time. by "learned" lists what the Org Graph learned after 23:59:59 UTC on from, up to 23:59:59 UTC on to, whatever date it took effect, so backdated corrections show, and a change it no longer believes comes back withdrawn. A change's effective_on is the first day it holds, so a leaving dated 30 April shows on 1 May. Defaults to a count per kind, with withdrawn changes counted apart; mode "full" lists every change. People are named by id only.

from.description: UTC date, YYYY-MM-DD. The day before the window opens.

to.description: UTC date, YYYY-MM-DD. The window's last day.

known_on.description: UTC date, YYYY-MM-DD. By effective date only; omit for what is known now.
